description: The FILE column type - the TYPE SURFACE only (the TO_FILE / FL_* function family is a separate concern): CREATE TABLE (f FILE) is accepted and DESCRIBE TABLE / SHOW COLUMNS (OBJECT-valued descriptor) / GET_DDL / INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS.DATA_TYPE all report FILE (not folded onto a family the way INTEGER folds onto NUMBER), ALTER TABLE adds FILE columns, NULL round-trips, a write of a missing stage path is rejected ('was not found' - the write path validates as TO_FILE does), FILE is NOT a cast target (::/CAST render the operand, TRY_CAST renders without the target type), not a structured element type, takes no type parameters, remains a plain identifier (column, alias, table, scripting variable), is a routine parameter and RETURNS type, a scripting variable type, and CTAS preserves it. Converted 1:1 from features/FileTypeTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ft_desc (id INTEGER, f FILE)
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'F', UPPER("type"), NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE ft_isc (id INTEGER, f FILE)
SELECT UPPER(data_type) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'FT_ISC' AND column_name = 'F'
SELECT UPPER(data_type) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'FT_ISC' AND column_name = 'ID'
CREATE TABLE ft_ddl (id INTEGER, f FILE)
ALTER TABLE ft_alter ADD COLUMN g FILE
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'G', UPPER("type"), NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))
CREATE TABLE ft_null (id INTEGER, f FILE)
SELECT id FROM ft_null WHERE f IS NULL
CREATE TABLE ft_write (id INTEGER, f FILE)
UPDATE ft_write SET f = '@ft_stage/no_such_file.txt' WHERE id = 2
